blocker_detail: The opt-in support check passes in a GPU container on spark5, but the full TP=2 launch was not rerun because spark4 stopped accepting SSH banners after the prior BatchedMarlin graph-capture probe. The next measurement is a clean TP=2 Spark4/Spark5 or alternate-pair launch with this patch and DS4_VLLM_ENABLE_GB10_FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MOE=1.
interpretation: The best current perf lead is no longer the Python BatchedMarlin packer. GB10 can pass the existing FlashInfer TRTLLM MXFP4 backend support gate with a narrow opt-in capability patch, and that path uses the standard routed-MoE kernel interface rather than a repo-written packing workaround.
required_next_command: Apply scripts/patch_vllm_ds4_gb10_flashinfer_moe.py as a vLLM mod, launch DeepSeek-V4-Flash TP=2 no-MTP with DS4_VLLM_ENABLE_GB10_FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MOE=1, verify log selects FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MXFP4_MXFP8 instead of MARLIN, then run c64/c128/c512 mixed fanout against the 174.190 tok/s baseline.
support_probe_command: docker run --rm --gpus all -v /tmp/patch_vllm_ds4_gb10_flashinfer_moe.py:/tmp/patch.py:ro --entrypoint bash vllm-node-dsv4 -lc 'python3 /tmp/patch.py /usr/local/lib/python3.12/dist-packages/vllm --write && DS4_VLLM_ENABLE_GB10_FLASHINFER_TRTLLM_MOE=1 python3 -c ...'
